items.target: 가는 말이 고와야 오는 말이 곱다.
items.pronunciation: ganeun mari gowaya oneun mari gopda.
items.translation: Nice words bring nice words back.
Look before you leap (Lit: Tap even a stone bridge before crossing).

items.target: 한국은 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울의 사계절이 있습니다. 봄에는 예쁜 꽃이 피고 날씨가 따뜻합니다.
items.pronunciation: hangugeun bom, yeoreum, gaeul, gyeoureui sagaejeori isseumnida. bomeneun yeppeun kkoti pigo nalssiga ttatteut-hamnida.
items.translation: Korea has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. In spring, pretty flowers bloom and the weather is warm.

items.target: 한글은 세종대왕이 1443년에 만든 한국의 문자입니다. 한글은 배우기 쉽고 과학적인 글자입니다.
items.pronunciation: hangeureun sejongdaewangi 1443nyeone mandeun hangugui munjaimnida. hangeureun baeugi swipgo gwahakjeogin geuljaimnida.
items.translation: Hangeul is the Korean alphabet created by King Sejong in 1443. Hangeul is easy to learn and scientific.

items.target: 지난 주말에 친구와 함께 제주도로 여행을 갔습니다. 제주도의 푸른 바다가 참 아름다웠습니다.
items.pronunciation: jinan jumare chinguwa hamkke jejudoro yeohaengeul gatseumnida. jejudoe pureun badaga cham areumdawotseumnida.
items.translation: Last weekend I went on a trip to Jeju Island with my friend. Jeju Island's blue sea was very beautiful.

items.target: 저는 아침 일곱 시에 일어나서 운동을 합니다. 아침을 먹고 지하철을 타고 회사에 갑니다.
items.pronunciation: jeoneun achim ilgop sie ireonaseo eundongeul hamnida. achimeul meokgo jihacheoreul tago hoesae gamnida.
items.translation: I wake up at seven in the morning and exercise. After eating breakfast, I take the subway to work.

items.target: 정직한 나무꾼이 산에서 나무를 하다가, 실수로 쇠도끼를 호수에 빠뜨렸습니다.
items.pronunciation: jeongjikan namukkuni saneseo namureul hadaga, silsuro soedokkireul hosue ppattryeotseumnida.
items.translation: An honest woodcutter accidentally dropped his iron axe into a lake while chopping wood in the mountains.

items.target: 옛날 옛날에 흥부하고 놀부라는 형제가 살았습니다.
items.translation: Once upon a time, there lived two brothers named Heungbu and Nolbu.

items.target: 흥부는 마음씨가 착했지만, 놀부는 아주 욕심이 많았습니다.
items.pronunciation: Heungbu-neun maeumssiga chak-hajiman, Nolbu-neun aju yoksim-i manatseumnida.
items.translation: Heungbu had a kind heart, but Nolbu was very greedy.
Nolbu kicked Heungbu's family out of the house.

items.target: 흥부 가족은 아주 가난하게 초가집에 살았습니다.
items.pronunciation: Heungbu gajok-eun aju gananhage chogajib-e saratseumnida.
items.translation: Heungbu's family lived very poverty in a thatched house.

items.target: 어느 날 흥부는 다리가 부러진 제비를 정성껏 치료해 주었습니다.
items.pronunciation: Eoneu nal Heungbu-neun dari-ga bureojin jebi-reul jeongseongkkeot chiryo-hae juotseumnida.
items.translation: One day, Heungbu carefully treated a swallow that had a broken leg.
As a reward, the swallow brought a gourd seed to Heungbu.

items.target: 흥부가 박을 타자 금과 은이 쏟아져 나왔습니다.
items.pronunciation: Heungbu-ga bak-eul taja geum-gwa eun-i ssodajyeo nawatseumnida.
items.translation: When Heungbu opened the gourd, gold and silver poured out.

items.target: 욕심꾸러기 놀부는 제비의 다리를 일부러 부러뜨렸습니다.
items.translation: The greedy Nolbu intentionally broke the swallow's leg.

items.target: 놀부의 박에서는 도깨비들이 나와 재산을 다 빼앗았습니다.
items.pronunciation: Nolbu-ui bak-eseon dokkaebi-deuri nawa jaesan-eul da ppaeatseumnida.
items.translation: Goblins came out of Nolbu's gourd and took all his wealth.

items.target: 옛날에 아주 배고픈 오누이가 살았습니다. 오누이는 떡을 가지고 길을 가고 있었습니다.
items.pronunciation: Yennari aju baegopeun onu-iga saratseumnida. Onu-ineun tteok-eul gajigo gireul gago isseotseumnida.
items.translation: Once upon a time, there lived very hungry siblings. The siblings were walking on the road with rice cakes.

items.target: 그때 무서운 호랑이가 나타나 "떡 하나 주면 안 잡아먹겠다!"라고 말했습니다.
items.pronunciation: Geuttae museoun horangi-ga natanaseo "tteok hana jumyeon an jabaeomokgetda!" rago malhaetseumnida.
items.translation: At that time, a scary tiger appeared and said, "Give me a rice cake, and I won't eat you!"

items.target: 오누이는 하늘에 올라가기 위해 하늘에 기도를 했습니다. 하늘에서 튼튼한 밧줄이 내려왔고, 오누이는 하늘로 올라가 해와 달이 되었습니다.
items.pronunciation: Onu-ineun haneul-e ollagagi wihae haneul-e gidoreotseumnida. Haneul-eseo teun-teun-han batjul-i naeryeowatgo, onu-ineun haneul-lo ollaga hae-wa dal-i doe-eotseumnida.
items.translation: The siblings prayed to the heavens to ascend to the sky. A sturdy rope descended from the sky, and the siblings ascended to the sky and became the sun and the moon.

items.target: 심청이는 눈먼 아버지를 위해 용기 있는 결정을 했습니다. 그녀는 아버지의 눈을 뜨게 하려고 인당수에 제물로 몸을 던졌습니다.
items.pronunciation: Shim Cheong-ineun nunmeon abeoji-reul wihae yonggi inneun gyeoljeong-eul haetseumnida. Geunyeo-neun abeoji-ui nuneul tteuge hallyogo Indangsu-e jemul-lo mom-eul deonjyeotseumnida.
items.translation: Shim Cheong made a brave decision for her blind father. To restore her father's sight, she threw herself into the Indangsu Sea as a sacrifice.

items.target: 심청이의 효심에 감동한 용왕님은 심청이를 다시 살려주었습니다. 결국 심청이의 아버지는 눈을 뜨게 되었고, 모두가 행복하게 살았습니다.
items.pronunciation: Shim Cheong-i-ui hyosim-e gamdong-han Yongwang-nim-eun Shim Cheong-i-reul dashi sallyeo-ju-eotseumnida. Gyeolguk Shim Cheong-i-ui abeoji-neun nuneul tteuge doe-eotgo, moduga haengbok-hage saratseumnida.
items.translation: Moved by Shim Cheong's filial piety, the Dragon King brought her back to life. In the end, Shim Cheong's father regained his sight, and everyone lived happily.

items.target: 용왕님이 큰 병에 걸려 몹시 아팠습니다. 의사는 토끼의 간을 먹어야 병이 나을 것이라고 했습니다.
items.pronunciation: Yongwang-nimi keun byeong-e geolryeo mop-si apatseumnida. Euisa-neun tokki-ui gan-eul meogeoya byeong-i naeul geosira-go haetseumnida.
items.translation: The Dragon King fell very ill and was in great pain. The doctor said he would only recover if he ate a rabbit's liver.

items.target: 거북이는 토끼를 잡기 위해 육지로 나갔습니다. 바다를 헤엄쳐 나와 육지의 숲을 찾았습니다.
items.pronunciation: Geobuk-ineun tokki-reul japgi wihae yukji-ro nagatseumnida. Bada-reul heeomchyeo nawa yukji-ui supeul chajatseumnida.
items.translation: The turtle went onto land to catch a rabbit. He swam out of the sea and searched the forests on land.

items.target: 거북이는 한 나무 아래에서 토끼를 만났습니다. 거북이는 토끼에게 용궁에 같이 가자고 말했습니다.
items.pronunciation: Geobuk-ineun han namu arae-eseo tokki-reul mannatsseumnida. Geobuk-ineun tokki-ege yonggung-e gachi gajago malhaetseumnida.
items.translation: The turtle met the rabbit under a tree. The turtle told the rabbit, "Let's go to the Dragon Palace together."

items.target: 용궁에 도착한 토끼는 깜짝 놀랐습니다. 용왕님이 토끼의 간을 먹으려고 했기 때문입니다.
items.pronunciation: Yonggung-e dochakhan tokki-neun kkamjjak nollatseumnida. Yongwang-nimi tokki-ui gan-eul meogeuryeo-go haetgi ttaemun-imnida.
items.translation: The rabbit was shocked when he arrived at the Dragon Palace. This was because the Dragon King intended to eat his liver.

items.target: 토끼는 재치 있게 "제 간은 육지에 두고 왔어요"라고 말했습니다. 거북이는 토끼의 말을 믿고 다시 육지로 향했습니다.
items.pronunciation: Tokki-neun jaechit itge "je gan-eun yukji-e dugo wasseoyo" rago malhaetseumnida. Geobuk-ineun tokki-ui mareul mitgo dashi yukji-ro hyanghaetseumnida.
items.translation: The rabbit cleverly said, "I left my liver back on land." The turtle believed the rabbit's words and headed back toward the land.

items.target: 육지에 도착한 토끼는 아주 빠르게 도망쳤습니다. 토끼는 무사히 숲으로 돌아갔습니다.
items.pronunciation: Yukji-e dochakhan tokki-neun aju ppareuge domangchyeotseumnida. Tokki-neun musahi supeuro doragasseumnida.
items.translation: Once on land, the rabbit ran away very quickly. The rabbit safely returned to the forest.
